title: Patch colours through Palettes only; quad-layout debug views out of MeshOverlayRuntime
description:
Repo plan merges 3D.21-22. Four patch-colour schemes: PatchColorHash.colorForPatch (hash HSV, mirrored in GLSL mesh_uv_traces.fs:24-40), geometry/mesh/data/PatchColors.uniquePatchColor (golden-ratio HSL), HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.stableTagColor (re-implements the golden ratio, returns Vector4f, 1305-1319), Palettes.PATCH. The user ruled Palettes is the preferred class: the other three go, and the GLSL side follows the palette (as a uniform) or is documented as the palette's mirror. mesh_scalar.fs:21-24 hard-codes a 4-stop ramp: feed it from a Palette. Separately, MeshOverlayRuntime (1436 lines) carries quad-layout-specific setters (setMotorcycleGraph, setCrossField, setConstraints, setEmbeddedTMesh, showPatchCovers, setSeamlessParametrization, 302-823): move them into a quad-layout overlay that feeds the generic overlay through LineSet/PointSet.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. PatchColorHash, PatchColors and stableTagColor are gone; every patch/tag colour comes from Palettes; no colour literal outside Color/Palettes (ColorOrderTest and the colour audit pass).
2. MeshOverlayRuntime has no quad-layout-specific setters.
3. Screenshots of patch and tag views and the quad-layout examination scenes (colours may change where schemes unify; show before/after to the user).
4. Unit suite passes; launch entry.
